changed_factors: Shared 64-frame FIFO memory, seven replay samples and velocity context
Global non-saturating loss and cosine schedule (start=0.5, floor=0.05)
Explicit replay_policy=none: train every arriving observation once, batch_size=1
Predict before arrival; learn next-frame targets from the preceding detached context
Causal state reader queries detached associative memory and carries current image, velocity, salient history and bounded repetition age in the existing 16-dimensional context

New observed-feature conditional prior: fixed named deterministic orthogonal 8x64 encoder; at most 32 latent feature means and 64 observed-context outcome counts; learn statistics only after successful current-observation updates

Freeze storage prior; learned additive conditional transform preserves each sampled MoG perturbation and task capacity, samples empirical feature quantiles at nearest past context; no image output bypass or stored-frame replay

G-phase posterior encodes only the current arrived frame; BCE reconstruction weight 10 trains the unchanged image decoder; D and serving use learned conditional prior without current target or generator probes
Ablate associative-history context term; retain appearance, velocity, salient content and repetition age

Parametric residual conditional prior: online float64 Sherman-Morrison RLS affine predictor plus Mahalanobis precision spike-and-slab prototype transport and empirical-Bayes kernel-gated live residual quantiles replace 1-NN context lookup on unseen states
Markov bottleneck regularizer (context_bypass_weight=5.0) penalizes direct generator input-context shortcut weights so held-out predictions decode through the conditional latent prior
